services.name: Pavilion & Group Area Rentals
services.desc: HCA has a variety of pavilions and group areas for you and your group to enjoy. Whether you’re coming for a family event or a large corporate picnic, we have the perfect spot for you! HCA Members receive 15% off pavilion and group area bookings!* *Discount not applicable to Confederation Beach Park, Wild Waterworks or wedding rentals. A charcoal BBQ is included with each rental, but you will be required to supply your own charcoal. Additional BBQ’s can be rented for a fee, and is dependent on availability.
